correctnessFindings.assessment: Existing bounded tails and parser carries now own their retained string bytes instead of retaining a substring that can pin a much larger parent allocation. Existing text, tail thresholds, and carry semantics are unchanged.
The shared helper preserves UTF-16 code units, including lone surrogates and NUL, with its Node copy path and browser fallback. Renderer code reuses its existing retained-slice helper.

The changed paths cover task text, mouse/kitty/OSC carries, plugin output, advertised URLs, recent PTY output, deferred reattach/error tails, check-job logs, command code output, and recovered session buffers.

originalReview.userVisibleBeforeAfter: Users retain the same text within the same pre-existing limits. The implementation releases large source strings earlier by copying the bounded retained part.
originalReview.capacityAndDataLoss: No new cap, cancellation, output dropping, or process policy. Copying adds work proportional to the retained tail; this is not a promise of zero CPU cost.

platformEvidence.assessment: The Node helper and browser fallback preserve JavaScript code units and do not modify path or native process behavior. Fresh Node tests ran on macOS; real Windows/Linux terminal I/O was not executed.
platformEvidence.executedHost: Fresh shared batch: macOS darwin arm64; Node 26.6.0. PRs outside that batch have no new execution in this follow-up.

originalReview.sshAndFolderCases: Local and SSH output passes through the same existing string ownership points. There is no host-side status inference or Git-worktree requirement.

regressionCoverage.description: The fresh batch contains the targeted retention tests for background tasks, mouse mode, plugins, URLs, recent PTY output, renderer capped buffers, check-job logs, command code, kitty keyboard, and OSC 133. The helper semantics were also inspected.

rootFocusedBatch.boundary: Root ran the current worktree after checking affected product bytes against nine published heads. Installed dependencies and transitive imports are current; this is not an exact historical full-source-graph execution. The 133 count is shared by the batch, not repeated per PR.

regressionCoverage.limitations: Fresh tests run current installed dependencies and are not a complete historical source-graph execution. Engine allocation observations are evidence about tested runtimes, not a universal substring representation guarantee.

dependencyAndMergeRisk.productAssessment: No additional production correctness defect established by this review; user-visible policy and performance consequences are explicitly separated from implementation correctness.
dependencyAndMergeRisk.ci: Root owns the final fresh CI snapshot. Focused green tests and old CI do not replace required checks on the published current head.
dependencyAndMergeRisk.merge: Review is tied to the named original head and merge-base product diff; GitHub UNKNOWN is not interpreted as a merge result.
